name: 11 POINT BLACK TILE
description: 11 Point Black Tile is a Hearts-style trick-taking game played with a double-six domino set. It uses negative scoring: the double-0 counts 4 points and each of the seven tiles in the 3-suit counts 1 point (11 points total per deal). Lower score wins. Three or four players pass three tiles left before play; the leader nominates the suit for each trick.

content.text: 11 Point Black Tile is a Hearts-style trick-taking game played with a double-six domino set. It uses negative scoring: the double-0 counts 4 points and each of the seven tiles in the 3-suit counts 1 point (11 points total per deal). Lower score wins. Three or four players pass three tiles left before play; the leader nominates the suit for each trick.
Adaptation of the card game Hearts for double-six dominoes; eight suits (0-6 plus doubles).
3 players: 9 tiles each (one face-down); 4 players: 7 tiles each
Each player passes 3 tiles face-down to the player on their left before play
